title: SG-5.1 · One owner for round types, admin routes agree with them
summary: Round Status, Round and CanTransition have one owner and the admin API is built on them
description: Context: backend/internal/round/round.go is now the only declaration of Status, Round and CanTransition, and go build ./... passes. But internal/admin.RoundService speaks world.Round while round.Service speaks round.Round, and server.New never mounts the admin round routes, so TestNew_AdminRoundsAreMounted fails with 404. Desired: the round, lifecycle and scheduler files agree on the same types and the backend serves them. Why: SG-5 lifecycle must be reachable.
acceptance_criteria: Given the backend tree, when go build ./... and go vet ./... run, then both succeed with Status, Round and CanTransition declared only in internal/round/round.go
Given server.New with admin.token tok, when each admin round endpoint is called with Bearer tok, then the response is not 404
Given a round.Service error, when an admin round handler maps it, then ErrNotFound gives 404 and ErrIllegalTransition or ErrActiveRound gives 409

in_scope: mount admin round routes in server.New

technical_constraints: round package remains sole owner of Status, Round, CanTransition
definition_of_done: go build ./... and go test ./internal/server ./internal/round ./internal/admin pass
